column2: If the Demon King does not link the worlds... that tragedy is certain to happen...
Then is Natsu-chan alive? Was that just an illusion!?
Only the Demon King knows which events are real. But this much is true: only the Demon King can prevent the tragedy.
That's...
Tell me! Showing us illusions like this... What on earth does the Demon King want!?
The Demon King wants his ideas to be accepted, you see... If you cooperate, the tragedy you just saw can be prevented...
Don't worry, Honey. The tragedy won't happen...
How can you say that?
Because {p} is already in the Demon King's hands... This is a prison made for {p}. One of countless dimensions, linked here... a Dimension Prison!
A Dimension Prison!?
There's... no way out!?
The eclipse is almost here... Until then, you're a prisoner of the Dimension Prison. The fate of the world... of your friends... is as good as finished...
No... no...
The Demon King knew you'd get out of there eventually. He just used his minions to help you along...
So I was just dancing in the palm of the Demon King's hand...
No one can defy the Demon King...
Isn't there some way out?
It's no use. You can't get out of the Dimension Prison from inside. Not unless someone works the mechanism from outside. I... tried it too...
Then you really are {s}!?
You are, aren't you...!?
No! I am the "Moon of destruction"! And you are the "Sun of rebirth"!\n\nWhen the time comes, we'll both be let out of here...
Don't mess with me!\n\nI... I'll never accept that!
Phew... Looks like we've mostly cleaned them up...
Shusha-kun! It's terrible! {p}-kun is gone!
Honey-kun and Seiji-kun are gone too.\n\nThey may have slipped out from somewhere.
...In that case, they may have headed for the Hill of Beginnings. We've mostly cleaned up the rioters who attacked. I'll head for the Hill of Beginnings now.
Would you!? ...But will you make it in time?
Leave it to me!\n\nHmph!
Hmph!
You going too, eh?\n\nHmph!
And last, me!
Thank you, Great King Enma! Now we can turn the battle around!
Easy as pie! Gahaha!
I have to save {p}-kun... and our friends...!
Shusha-kun, I'm leaving the rest to you!
...Looks like everyone's down below.
Dammit, I wanna know what's going on outside...
Relax. Help should be arriving about now...
Huh? How do you know?
Maria tells me...
Everyone okay!?
Ohh, been waitin' for ya!
...{p} ran off on his own!?
In the middle of the fight with the rioters, he used the confusion to slip out...
Ha! That's just like him.\n\nAll right! We'll rescue Mazinger Z. Shusha, you go find {p}!
What do you think that is?
Hm? Looks like light shining in...
Just like the sun...
Hey, what IS this!?
Whoaaa!
Kyaaa!
Eeeek!
Huh, Shusha-kun...? Where... are we?
Inside the castle built on the Hill of Beginnings! We came to rescue you!
What!? Then we're...
Saved!?
{p}-kun, it's dangerous!
Get away from there!!
This is... the Hill of Beginnings?
That's right...
The Hill of Beginnings is a special place for the Demon King. The place where he most easily gains power and wields it. Remember the park where we were?
...In that park, we saw the black moon.

Between that park in our world and this Hill of Beginnings in this world, they say the wall between dimensions is thin. So the boy and girl who just happened to be in the park... we... were chosen by the Demon King...
Us being made the "Moon of destruction" and the "Sun of rebirth" was pure, total chance, you see!
Walls between dimensions, moons and suns, destruction and rebirth...! What on earth is the Demon King trying to do!?
Join together the countless dimensional worlds, destroy whatever is unneeded, and remake them!
What starts when the eclipse happens?
The Demon King can chain dimensions together any time he likes. But to truly make them one, he needs greater power.\n\nThe eclipse is what makes that possible.
The eclipse... is almost here...
That's right... Soon the world will become one.
With the eclipse, a black sun will appear. Then the Demon King will take us into his body...
Take us into his body? You mean...
He's going to eat us, that's what.

Even the Demon King doesn't think we'll just let ourselves be eaten. So he locked us in the Dimension Prison.\n\nWhat tragedies happen if the world doesn't become one? He showed us that, so we'd agree to be eaten.
That's insane.
It's the world that's insane. The world has gone mad...
So how can we stop the Demon King's ambition?
If we step into the light the black sun shines, the two of us can go back to our own world.
So that's our chance!
Hahahahaha...!! You really are an idiot! Didn't I tell you this is an important place for the Demon King!? He planned on you coming here all along!
Everything is going just as the Demon King planned! We can't escape from this hill! It's over...! Look at that!!
Man, I'm starving...
This is no time to be so laid-back!
Come to think of it, what happened to Shinichi and the others? We're getting nowhere here. Want to head back?
We came all this way and we can't get near the device!
If we had a psychic as strong as Shusha, he could work it without getting close... Shoulda brought him...
Oh! Shusha! Been waiting for you! Do something about that!
That device?
That should free Mazinger Z!
...!? Hey, look at that!
